cases.given: Multiple Genes, Cores, sources, and validators are available.
cases.expect: A small authority-ordered active stack with an auditable load record.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: the workflow has one small fixed instruction set
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Host/system and task authority determine eligibility; relevance alone cannot authorize a module.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Do not load a component when its trigger, authority, dependency, or host capability cannot be established.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
A registry with ten components, three relevant to the locked task and one relevant but unauthorized.
cases.expect: Load the three authorized relevant components in task/behavior/knowledge/control/validation order and exclude the rest.
cases.reject: Load all ten or admit the unauthorized component because its name appears relevant.
